ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 75:25 ratio of low-intensity dark pixels (black/charcoal) to high-intensity light pixels (white/off-white).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation covers the central and proximal areas. High-intensity white pigmentation is localized to the distal lateral tips of both lobes. Fine white speckling/mottling is distributed across the central dark region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of approximately 70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency irregular serration along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by numerous small peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of small white circular spots throughout the central black field. Large, irregular, textured clusters are present at the extreme lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct white diagonal linear marks (rake marks) are visible on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, brownish-gray calcified clusters (barnacles) are attached to the distal tips of both lobes. Multiple linear scratches are visible on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of heavy terminal biological encrustation and extensive internal white mottling provides a unique pixel signature.
